result.title: Counting Symbols on Technical Drawings: A Benchmark and Verified Rewards for MLLMs
result.summary: Today's MLLMs can count objects in natural images. However, when asking them how many bolt holes appear in a mechanical drawing or how many nitrogen atoms are in a chemical structure, they often struggle. Counting in technical drawings remains challenging, as objects can be small, densely packed, or even implied by drawing conventions. To study this problem, we introduce CountDrawBench, a benchmark including floor plans, electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and molecular structures, with 1,574 counting questions and instance-level annotations where available. Besides evaluation, we introduce Code-Verified RL, a reinforcement learning framework that teaches MLLMs to count with executable feedback. Our method combines three complementary rewards: a count reward that checks the final answer, an instance-matching reward that verifies object locations, and a zoom-based reward that checks counting consistency across local image regions. All three are integrated into a unified GRPO objective. Extensive experiments reveal that even leading MLLMs struggle on CountDrawBench, with the best evaluated model achieving only 59.3% accuracy. Our method improves Qwen3.5-9B from 49.3% to 54.3% accuracy, outperforming all evaluated open-source baselines. These results establish CountDrawBench as a challenging testbed for technical drawing understanding and demonstrate the value of code-verified rewards in these tasks. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建 CountDrawBench，覆盖平面图、电路图、机械图与分子结构共 1,574 道计数题并提供实例级标注，同时提出 Code-Verified RL，用答案计数、实例位置匹配和局部放大一致性三种可执行奖励经 GRPO 训练 MLLM。
AI.relevance_reason: 计数细小、密集或约定隐含的符号，直接考察 VLM 是否在内部保留并利用视觉细节，实例匹配与 zoom 奖励可供核查 LOOK 式局部证据筛选与奖励分配的效果，但论文不涉及 latent 推理状态生成。
